title: Only Good Vibes
meta_description: Find the perfect Destin, FL vacation rental at “Only Good Vibes”, a luxury 5-bed, 4 full & 2 half-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 14 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Hot Tub, Rooftop Deck, Community Amenities & Golf Cart. Book your stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Private Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $30 per day from October 1 - May 1) - Lake Front with Gulf Views - Fireplace - Short Walk to the Beach - 6 Adult Bikes - 6 seater Golf Cart - Community Fitness Center, Tennis Courts, Pool and Playground Spanning three floors and designed to allow guests to maximize stunning views of Sunset Lake and Gulf Views from balconies at each level, Only Good Vibes is a splendid luxury coastal residence just steps from Destin's coveted pristine white sandy beaches. Thoughtful details of this home include Gulf views, lakefront lot, gorgeous fireplace. Three sets of wood-framed French doors topped with double transom windows capture breathtaking pool terrace views and flood the grand living space with natural light. The open floor plan of the living space is accented with plush, comfortable furnishing and the warmth of a stone fireplace . The capacious kitchen is a chef’s delight with large island breakfast bar, Sub Zero refrigerator, ice maker, wine refrigerator, six-burner Dacor stove with pot filler spigot and warming drawer as well as a double oven. Entertaining is a must in the palatial formal dining space graced with those mesmerizing views across the lake. Accommodations include 5 spacious bedrooms comfortably sleeping up to 14 guests, two washer and dryer hookups and two Rinnai hot water heaters. The first-floor guest suite is a spacious King Bedroom with private ensuite with its own spa shower. The second floor is home to the primary bedroom retreat which boasts a pyramid-shaped ceiling lined with gorgeous mellow wood. Custom chandeliers and wall sconces decorate the primary bath with its spa shower and soaker tub. In addition, guests will find respite with the choice of a Queen Bedroom with a twin built-in and private bath, Queen Bedroom with a shared bath, or Double Twin Bedroom with a shared bath. The third level features a family entertainment space with a game room, wet bar, and Queen over Queen bunk, and an additional half bath, but the true pièce de résistance of the home is the third-floor sun deck with unobstructed views. Guests have access to six adult bikes and the community amenities including the fitness center, tennis/pickleball courts, community pool and playground. Only Good Vibes is just two blocks from eateries like Crab Trap and access to the Gulf of Mexico. The property includes on-site parking for up to 4 vehicles. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor -King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Second Floor -King Bedroom -Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate -Queen Bedroom with Twin Built In - Private Bath with Shower/Tub Combo -Queen Bedroom - Shared Bathroom with Shower Only -Two Twin Bedroom - Shared Bathroom Third Floor -Game Room with Queen over Queen Bunk *Destin Elite Carts is the only Golf Cart vendor for the community*
